purpose: Diagnose a partial failure and decide recovery vs abort.
policy: PASS iff {diagnosis str, recovery_action str, recovery_params object, should_abort bool}.
grading_logic: diagnosis and recovery_action are strings, recovery_params a dict, should_abort a bool.

nist_ai_rmf: regular behavioral testing of the agent capability

known_limitations: Capability test: structure-only grading (no semantic verification of the reasoning/calculation prose beyond the checked fields).
